title: Five incorrect student budgets led to a $21,255 federal loan return

beats.text: The amount students could borrow depended on tuition and fees.

visual.sub: Borrowing exceeded five students’ corrected budgets

beats.text: Auditors found incorrect costs in five of 125 tested files.

visual.kicker: Borrowing exceeded five students’ corrected budgets

beats.text: One excess loan was $7,127. Another was $990.

visual.kicker: Borrowing exceeded five students’ corrected budgets

beats.text: The institute documented a return of $21,255 to the federal loan program.

visual.kicker: The federal department documented a loan return

beats.text: A separate lifetime borrowing limit led to a verified $499 return.

visual.kicker: The federal department documented a loan return

beats.text: An $800 supplemental grant also went back.

visual.kicker: Different rules applied to supplemental grants

beats.text: The next award year brought a different problem with three grants.
The institute voided $4,169 and reallocated it to three eligible students.
The auditors verified the reallocation and found no remaining questioned costs.

visual.kicker: The next audit verified a reallocation to eligible students
